arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The government advocate argued the appellate court correctly applied a presumption of reasonableness.
the side that brought the case advocate argued judges are no longer bound by the specific guideline range.
Justice Breyer questioned whether a judge must provide more than a simple guideline citation.
Justice Scalia asked how to reconcile conflicting statutory language regarding sentencing reasons.
